 Nepal Premier League Cricket: Two Crucial Matches Today
 Ratopati
 November 13, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Two important matches are being played today in the third edition of Nepal Premier League (NPL) Cricket. The first match between Kathmandu Gurkhas and Sudurpaschim Royals will be held at TU International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur, while the second match will be a competition between Chitwan Rhinos and Janakpur Bolts. As the league stage matches approach their end, Friday's results can be decisive for all four teams. While Kathmandu and Sudurpaschim are in the race for the top spot, Chitwan is aiming to secure its position. On the other hand, Janakpur has no option but to win to keep its playoff hopes alive. Considering the performance so far and past encounters in previous editions, both matches are expected to be highly competitive.
 First Match: Battle for Top Spot Between Kathmandu and Sudurpaschim 
 The first match on Friday will start at 12:30 PM. Both teams have won four matches each in the current edition. However, Kathmandu has played five matches, losing one, while Sudurpaschim has played six matches, losing two. As per the points table until Thursday, Kathmandu is in second place with 8 points, and Sudurpaschim is in third place with the same 8 points, based on net run rate.
 Kathmandu has made an excellent comeback in the tournament, winning the last four consecutive matches. After being defeated by Lumbini Lions in the first match, Kathmandu defeated Karnali Yaks by 4 wickets, Biratnagar Kings by 9 wickets, Lumbini by 36 runs, and Chitwan Rhinos by 10 runs. In the recent matches, both Kathmandu's batting and bowling have appeared balanced. Foreign players like Rashid Khan and Jahandad Khan have also made significant contributions to the team.
 On the other hand, Sudurpaschim has also performed impressively in this edition. After being defeated by Lumbini by 7 wickets in the first match, Sudurpaschim defeated Pokhara by 6 wickets. The team, defeated by 35 runs in a match limited to 5 overs due to rain, then defeated Chitwan by 5 wickets, Karnali by 39 runs, and in the last match, Janakpur by 27 runs. Captain Dipendra Singh Airee, Scott Kuggeleijn, and Brandon McMullen are the main weapons for Sudurpaschim.
 'Head to Head' Sudurpaschim is Stronger 
 In the previous two editions of the NPL, Sudurpaschim has won both matches played between these two teams. In the first edition, Kathmandu, chasing a target of 167 runs set by Sudurpaschim, was bowled out for 94, suffering a 73-run defeat. In the second edition as well, Kathmandu was limited to 118 runs in response to Sudurpaschim's 147, losing by 29 runs. Kathmandu, trailing 2-0 in past 'head to head' encounters, has an opportunity to take revenge on their home ground this time. Meanwhile, Sudurpaschim will enter the field with the plan to maintain its unbeaten record.
 Second Match: Chitwan Gets a Chance to Secure, Janakpur's 'Do or Die' 
 The second match, starting at 5 PM on Friday, will be very high-pressure for both Chitwan and Janakpur. In the points table, Chitwan is in fourth place with 5 points from 5 matches, with two wins, two losses, and one match abandoned. Janakpur, on the other hand, is limited to fourth place with 4 points from 6 matches, with two wins and four losses.
 Chitwan had a good start by defeating Biratnagar by 8 runs in the first match. After the match against Lumbini was abandoned due to rain, Chitwan lost to Sudurpaschim by 5 wickets but defeated Pokhara by 30 runs. However, in the last match, the team was defeated by Kathmandu by 10 runs. Ravi Bopara, Sikandar Raza, Dan Mösley, and Kushal Malla are the key players for Chitwan. Especially in the middle order, the performance of experienced players like Bopara and Raza is crucial for the team.
 On the other hand, Janakpur, which has not been able to follow its previous form, has had a fluctuating performance this time. After being defeated by Biratnagar by 2 runs and Karnali by 19 runs, Janakpur picked up form by defeating Kathmandu by 8 wickets and Pokhara by 9 runs. However, since then, the team has lost three consecutive matches – by 2 runs against Biratnagar, by 16 runs against Lumbini, and by 27 runs against Sudurpaschim in the last match. Captain Hrmit Singh, Saif Hassan, and other foreign players will play a crucial role for Janakpur. Improving the instability seen in batting has become Janakpur's main challenge.
 'Head to Head' Chitwan and Janakpur are Tied 
 In the previous two editions, the results of the matches between these two teams are tied at 1-1. In the first edition, Chitwan, with Kushal Malla's 72 runs off 41 balls, scored 180/5 and restricted Janakpur to 148, winning by 32 runs. In the second edition, Janakpur took revenge. Janakpur completed the target of 176/4 set by Chitwan in 17.3 overs, losing 4 wickets, with Maz Sadakat's 63 (30 balls) and Anil Sah's 61 (36 balls). The team that wins on Friday will take the lead in 'head to head' encounters. After Biratnagar defeated Pokhara and Lumbini defeated Karnali by 4 wickets each on Thursday, the race for the top four has become even more intense. As only the top four teams will qualify for the playoffs from the league stage, both matches on Friday will give a clear direction to the equation for the final four of the tournament.
